routeMarks.name: Chalk Wingmark
routeMarks.description: The first time enemy Cover is broken each turn, gain 3 Cover, gain 1 Resonance, and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A snapped roofing slate dusted with old crossing chalk. The flock still reads the angle of the wing.

routeMarks.name: Rooftop Shortcut
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost with unspent Wingbeat each combat, draw 1 extra and gain +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bent antenna tag scratched with three ledges, two vents, and one route only locals trust.

routeMarks.name: Patched Harness
routeMarks.description: After each Market purchase, regain 10 Scrap, carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight, and soften the next Open Sky increase by 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: An old market harness with every buckle replaced at least twice and every patch earned.

routeMarks.name: Quiet Landing
routeMarks.description: The first Open Sky damage increase each combat is reduced by 2, and the flock gains +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A rubber pad cut from an old rooftop mat. It remembers how to land without announcing it.

routeMarks.name: Loose Change Tin
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing cards without overextending each combat, gain 10 Scrap, retain 1 card, and gain 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A mint tin full of washers, transit screws, and coins too shiny to leave behind.

routeMarks.name: Rain Gutter
routeMarks.description: Basin Stops heal 4 more Cohesion, carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight, and soften the next Open Sky increase by 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bright strip of gutter metal bent into a perch sign. It points toward clean water after hard crossings.

routeMarks.name: Wire Map
routeMarks.description: Signals pay out 10 Scrap, carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight, and soften the next Open Sky increase by 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: A folded scrap of mesh wire that turns bad directions into profitable detours.

routeMarks.name: Feather Tape
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Basins card each turn, heal 3 Cohesion and cleanse 1 negative status.
routeMarks.flavorText: A roll of soft repair tape used for feathers, harnesses, and the sort of morale nobody admits needs mending.

routeMarks.name: Patched Shoulder Wrap
routeMarks.description: The first time an enemy turn deals no Cohesion damage each combat, gain 4 Cover and retain 1 card.
routeMarks.flavorText: A rain-dark cloth wrap repaired with careful beak-stitches and roof-tar thread.

routeMarks.name: Tin Roof Shade
routeMarks.description: The first Open Sky damage increase each combat is reduced by 1, then gain 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A palm-sized square of corrugated tin, polished bright on one edge and tied under the wing.

routeMarks.name: Borrowed Raincoat
routeMarks.description: The first Open Sky damage increase each combat is reduced by 2, then recover 3 Cohesion.
routeMarks.flavorText: A tiny waxed hood and shoulder cape passed between crews when the weather turns mean.

routeMarks.name: Rooftop Nest Lining
routeMarks.description: The first time an enemy turn deals no Cohesion damage each combat, gain 8 Cover, draw 1 extra next turn, and retain 1 card.
routeMarks.flavorText: Soft insulation pulled from an abandoned vent and woven into a travel roll.

routeMarks.name: Signal Whistle
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing cards without overextending each combat, gain 1 Open Sky Guard and +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bottlecap whistle tuned to a warning pitch that carries between HVAC stacks.

routeMarks.name: Courier Thread
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing 1 or 2 cards each combat, draw 1 extra next turn and retain 1 card.
routeMarks.flavorText: A red thread knotted with delivery stops, carried because the path is easier to follow by feel.

routeMarks.name: Loose Feather Token
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing 1 or 2 cards each combat, gain +1 Wingbeat and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A molted feather tucked in a transit-card sleeve. Someone marked it as good luck and meant it.

routeMarks.name: Wind-Step Tag
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost with cards still in hand each combat, gain +1 Wingbeat next turn and retain 1 card.
routeMarks.flavorText: A toe tag from a courier crew, etched with footwork for crossing wet parapets.

routeMarks.name: Bright Bottlecap
routeMarks.description: Start each combat with 2 Open Sky Guard and 1 Resonance, then draw 1 extra card and gain +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A polished cap that catches sunrise and tells the flock which roofs are exposed.

routeMarks.name: Rooftop Relay Bell
routeMarks.description: The first time you use a Supply each combat, gain 1 Wingbeat and draw 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: A tiny brass bell from a signal mast. One clean ring can move a whole crew.

routeMarks.name: Market Tally String
routeMarks.description: Signals pay out 15 Scrap, carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight, and soften the next Open Sky increase by 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: Colored knots for favors owed, debts forgiven, and which stalls will trade in rain.

routeMarks.name: Cache Hook
routeMarks.description: Rooftop Caches offer 1 extra reward choice and pay out 8 Scrap.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bent hook clipped to a harness loop, good for lifting loose lids without slowing down.

routeMarks.name: Courier's Ledger
routeMarks.description: Gain 20 extra Scrap after each Street Encounter, carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight, and soften the next Open Sky increase by 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: A waterproof pocket ledger that turns cleared crossings into names, favors, and parts.

routeMarks.name: Roofline Compass
routeMarks.description: Rooftop Caches offer 2 extra reward choices and pack a random Supply if there is room.
routeMarks.flavorText: A weighted washer that knows where a route wants to turn.

routeMarks.name: Stage Pin
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Plumes card each turn, gain 1 Open Sky Guard, 1 Resonance, +1 Wingbeat next turn, and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bright enamel pin from a Plumes rooftop show, still sharp enough to fasten confidence in place.

routeMarks.name: Dawn Ribbon
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost with cards still in hand each combat, draw +1 next turn and retain 1 card.
routeMarks.flavorText: A faded orange ribbon tied where the morning routes catch first light.

routeMarks.name: Parade Mirror
routeMarks.description: The first time you play your third card in a turn each combat, gain 1 Resonance and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A thumb-sized mirror that lets a performer read the whole roofline without turning around.

routeMarks.name: Quill Notch
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Quills card each turn, gain 3 Cover and 1 Resonance.
routeMarks.flavorText: A scored metal sliver used by Quills crews to mark where pressure will land.

routeMarks.name: Razor Kite Tail
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing cards without overextending each combat, gain 4 Cover, gain 1 Resonance, and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A strip from a signal kite, frayed by fast turns and kept for sharper timing.

routeMarks.name: Black Ink Pin
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost with cards still in hand each combat, gain 1 Resonance and retain up to 2 cards.
routeMarks.flavorText: A sealed ink pin from a rooftop tactician. It marks the decision before the fight begins.

routeMarks.name: Basin Charm
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost with Wingbeat unspent each combat, recover 3 Cohesion and gain 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A smooth blue bead threaded through a washer, cool even after a long exposed crossing.

routeMarks.name: Blue Cup Token
routeMarks.description: Basin Stops heal 5 more Cohesion, pack a random Supply if there is room, and carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight.
routeMarks.flavorText: A chipped measuring cup from a canal stall, kept because someone once filled it exactly when needed.

routeMarks.name: Harbor Bead Strand
routeMarks.description: The first time healing restores Cohesion each turn, draw 1 extra next turn and gain 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A strand of glass beads traded from the canal railings, one bead for each shelter that stayed open.

routeMarks.name: Scaffold Knot
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing 1 or 2 cards each combat, gain 5 Cover and make the next Nest Cover card stronger.
routeMarks.flavorText: A knot pattern Nests crews use when the crossing must hold under bad wind.

routeMarks.name: Workshop Stamp
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Nests card each turn, gain 5 Cover and make the next Nest Cover card stronger.
routeMarks.flavorText: A heavy stamp from a rooftop workshop, pressed into repairs that are expected to last.

routeMarks.name: Shed Feather Case
routeMarks.description: The first time you enter Molt each combat, gain 1 Open Sky Guard, 3 Cover, draw 1, and gain +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A clear case for one molted feather, carried as a reminder that change needs shelter.

routeMarks.name: Sunbreak Lens
routeMarks.description: The first Open Sky damage increase each combat is reduced by 2, then gain 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A scratched safety lens that turns harsh skyline glare into a usable warning.

routeMarks.name: Under-Eave Charm
routeMarks.description: The first Open Sky damage increase each combat is reduced by 1, then gain 4 Cover.
routeMarks.flavorText: A charm made from eave wire and shelter thread. It is plain until the sky gets too open.

routeMarks.name: Fresh Pinfeather
routeMarks.description: The first time you enter Molt each combat, gain 1 Wingbeat now and draw 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: A new feather sealed in wax paper, fragile and bright with the cost of becoming stronger.

routeMarks.name: Sky-Safe Harness
routeMarks.description: Start each combat with 1 Open Sky Guard. The flock starts boss fights with 16 extra Cover.
routeMarks.flavorText: A reinforced harness with sun-faded straps, built for the crossing everyone worries about.

routeMarks.name: Crowbar Debt
routeMarks.description: The first time enemy Cover is broken each turn, deal 5 damage to all enemies and gain 1 Resonance.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bent crowbar hook returned after the crossing opens. It still carries the weight of the bargain.

routeMarks.name: Reopened Roofline
routeMarks.description: At the start of the next district, gain 25 Scrap, Preen 2 cards for free, and pack up to 2 random Supplies if there is room.
routeMarks.flavorText: A real route sign, newly painted and impossible to miss. The city feels wider after it goes up.

routeMarks.name: Flock Counterweight
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost with cards still in hand each combat, gain 1 Cover per Waymark carried and +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A heavy washer tied low on the harness. Every found object steadies the next crossing a little more.

routeMarks.name: Supply Bell
routeMarks.description: After you use a Supply, draw 1 and the next Supply used this combat resolves twice.
routeMarks.flavorText: A small counter bell from a stall window. It rings once when the flock commits to using what it packed.

routeMarks.name: Molt Metronome
routeMarks.description: The first time you enter Molt each combat, draw 1 and gain +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A cracked timing charm that clicks faster when feathers loosen and the whole route changes rhythm.

routeMarks.name: Eave Bloom
routeMarks.description: The first time you enter Molt each combat, gain 6 Cover and make the next Nest Cover card stronger.
routeMarks.flavorText: A curled tin flower from under an eave, opening only when the flock has to become something new.

routeMarks.name: Plumes Busker Patch
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Plumes card each turn, gain 1 Resonance and +1 Wingbeat next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bright stage patch traded by rooftop performers. It turns first applause into a usable spark.

routeMarks.name: Quills Pressure Gauge
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Quills card each turn, deal 2 damage to all enemies and gain 2 Cover.
routeMarks.flavorText: A tiny cracked gauge from a rooftop compressor. It twitches when the cleanest line through a fight appears.

routeMarks.name: Basin Overflow Cup
routeMarks.description: The first time healing restores Cohesion each turn, gain 4 Cover and 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A dented blue cup that never wastes the last sip; whatever spills becomes shelter.

routeMarks.name: Nest Ratchet
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Nests card each turn, the next Nest Cover card gains +4 Cover and the flock gains 1 Open Sky Guard.
routeMarks.flavorText: A palm-sized ratchet with green tape on the handle. Every first brace tightens the next one.

routeMarks.name: Broken Cover Chime
routeMarks.description: The first time enemy Cover is broken each turn, draw 1 and gain 1 Resonance.
routeMarks.flavorText: A cracked brass wind chime made from snipped wire and bottlecaps. It rings when a guarded route finally opens.

routeMarks.name: Spark Ground Clip
routeMarks.description: The first time you spend Resonance each combat, gain 7 Cover, draw 1, and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A tiny alligator clip biting a teal battery plate. It turns the leftover crackle into shelter.

routeMarks.name: Quiet Roost Token
routeMarks.description: The first time an enemy turn deals no Cohesion damage each combat, heal 3 and retain 1 card.
routeMarks.flavorText: A flat rubber roost pad stamped with a faded wing. If the flock holds clean, it gives a little back.

routeMarks.name: Double-Packed Buckle
routeMarks.description: After you use a Supply, gain 1 Wingbeat and the next Supply used this combat resolves twice.
routeMarks.flavorText: A heavy two-slot harness buckle with mirrored brass teeth. Good packing makes the next tool count twice.

routeMarks.name: Ledger Tab
routeMarks.description: After each Market purchase, regain 12 Scrap, carry 1 Open Sky Guard into the next fight, and soften the next Open Sky increase by 2.
routeMarks.flavorText: A black ledger tab with gold tally marks clipped to a torn receipt. Every fair trade leaves a little change.

routeMarks.name: Basin Safety Pin
routeMarks.description: The first time healing restores Cohesion each turn, reduce each flock debuff by 1 and gain 3 Cover.
routeMarks.flavorText: A blue enamel safety pin threaded through cloth wrap. Clean water, clean feathers, clean escape.

routeMarks.name: Nest Measure Line
routeMarks.description: The first time you play a Nests card each turn, retain 1 card and prime +3 Cover for the next Nest brace.
routeMarks.flavorText: A retractable tape line in a scratched green case. The next brace starts before the turn ends.

routeMarks.name: Plumes Applause Cap
routeMarks.description: The first time you Roost after playing cards without overextending each combat, gain 1 Resonance and draw 1 extra next turn.
routeMarks.flavorText: A purple bottlecap badge with gold wing embroidery. Clean timing makes the roofline answer.

routeMarks.name: Molt Shadow Tag
routeMarks.description: The first time you enter Molt each combat, gain 2 Open Sky Guard and draw 1.
routeMarks.flavorText: A dark translucent luggage tag holding one pale pinfeather. It makes the exposed moment shorter.

routeMarks.name: Cache Divining Hook
routeMarks.description: Rooftop Caches also pack a random Supply if there is room and pay out 12 Scrap.
routeMarks.flavorText: A bent copper hook tied to a glowing blue bead strand. It points toward the useful thing under the lid.
